title: achyrodes aureum
intro: Achyrodes aureum, commonly known as the Yellow Balsam, is a plant species that belongs to the family Malpighiaceae. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations.
